hero.title: Shahin
hero.subtitle: High-fidelity vehicle + plate tracking for safety-critical, edge-ready deployments.

about.title: About the Project
about.paragraph1: This modular orchestration captures vehicles and their license plates with laser-focused accuracy, funneling live video into state-of-the-art YOLOX detection, followed by custom character-block recognition.
about.paragraph2: Each pipeline stage is tuned for reliability under low light, motion blur, and crowded environments.

card1.title: Multi-class vehicle awareness
card1.copy: Classifies cars, buses, trucks, and motorcycles while estimating motion vectors for robust tracking.

card2.title: Precision plate framing
card2.copy: YOLO anchors tuned to local plate formats ensure crisp crops for downstream OCR.

card3.title: Custom OCR ensemble
card3.copy: A lightweight classifier trained on multilanguage datasets keeps recognition in-spec even off-network.

card4.title: Intelligent tracking
card4.copy: A tracking-aware database aligns vehicles to detections, enabling analytics-ready history.
